name: ideahose
title: ideahose
blurb: watches the entire live firehose — not just posts tagging the bot — for anything that sounds like a website/app idea, groups the ones different people separately keep having, and ranks the backlog by mentions, real post reactions, and upvotes cast right here. tap "tag @buildthis" on whichever one you want built next. @words.bsky.social asked for a way to crowdsource and rank build ideas straight off the firehose.
